definitions.ask: Should `check_ignore_quiet` fail closed on a rel path that starts with `:`?
definitions.why: a `:x` probe silently answers for `x`; the guard is three lines and callers handle the error

choices.label: Fail closed with the existing error shape so git can never misparse a probe as pathspec magic
No new guard; leading-`:` paths keep their pre-hardening misparse behavior
